acquisition_method.evidence: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed using data-independent acquisition (DIA).
experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The data were searched with the reviewed part of the human proteome UniProtKB database as of May 2022 with max 1 missed cleavage and fixed cysteine carbamidomethylation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: PAC digestion (protein aggregation capture) of the lysates was performed with a mixture of LysC (1:500) and trypsin (1:250).
PAC digestion (protein aggregation capture) of the lysates was performed with a mixture of LysC (1:500) and trypsin (1:250).

collision_energy.evidence: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed using data-independent acquisition (DIA). For 21 min runs the DIA method used an MS1 scan range from 350 to 1400 m/z, 120,000 resolution, maximum 25 ms injection time with 3E6 target, MS/MS used default charge 2, loop count 49, 15,000 resolution, 13.7 m/z isolation windows, NCE 27, 22 ms maximum injection time with 3E6 target, with DIA window centers from 471.5 to 1129.1 m/z.

For 58 min runs MS1 scans were from 395 to 1005 m/z, 60,000 resolution, 55 ms maximum injection time with 3E6 target, with centroid acquisition. For MS/MS default charge 3, resolution 15,000, Auto maximum injection time with 1E6 target, NCE27, loop count 75, 8 m/z windows, with a total of 151 staggered windows with centers between 400.4 and 1000.7 m/z.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphorylated peptides were enriched using the KingFisher Flex Robot along with MagResyn® Ti-IMAC HP beads (Resyn Biosciences).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Peptides and phosphopeptides were analyzed using an Evosep One (Evosep) Q Exactive HF-X Orbitrap (Thermo Scientific) LC-MS system.

ptm.evidence: The data were searched with the reviewed part of the human proteome UniProtKB database as of May 2022 with max 1 missed cleavage and fixed cysteine carbamidomethylation.
Phosphoenriched data were searched with max one variable phospho (STY) for the cell line landscape data and max two phospho (STY) for the treatment data.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Cells at 70–80% confluency were lysed using boiling lysing buffer (5% SDS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Vilnius, Lithuania), 0.1 M TRIS pH 8.5 (Thermo Scientific, Rockford, IL), 10 mM 2-CAA (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) and 5 mM TCEP (Thermo Scientific, Rockford, IL) dissolved in LC/MS grade dH2O (Fischer chemical, Ottawa) and transferred into low protein binding tubes.
